name: Lake Pointe Market
summary: Lake Pointe Market is a community shopping center in Rowlett, Texas, managed by Phillips Edison & Company. Conveniently located on Dalrock Road, it serves as a neighborhood retail hub with strong community ratings and daily accessibility.
demographics: Lake Pointe Market serves the growing suburban community of Rowlett, Texas, attracting primarily middle-income families and young professionals in the Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area. The trade area consists of established residential neighborhoods with household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $100,000, featuring a mix of homeowners and renters aged 25-54. Shoppers typically visit for convenient grocery shopping, everyday services, and quick-service dining options, with strong weekday evening and weekend traffic patterns reflecting the needs of working families seeking accessible neighborhood retail.
description: Lake Pointe Market is a well-positioned community shopping center located at 6702 Dalrock Road in Rowlett, Texas, serving the northeastern Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area. Managed by Phillips Edison & Company, a leading owner and operator of grocery-anchored shopping centers, this property provides essential retail and service offerings to the growing Rowlett community. The center benefits from its strategic location along Dalrock Road, offering convenient access to local residents and commuters in this thriving suburban market. With a strong rating of 4.3 stars from over 700 reviews, Lake Pointe Market has established itself as a trusted neighborhood destination for everyday shopping needs. The center operates daily from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM, providing consistent accessibility for the community it serves.
